## 2. Full 37-SKU Technical Specifications & Laboratory Parameters
### MZ-CAT-01: Elastomeric SBS Modified Bitumen Waterproof Membrane
- **Category**: Modified Bitumen & Shingles
- **Execution Standards**: GB 18242-2008 / ASTM D6164 / EN 13707
- **Nominal Thickness / Spec**: 3.0mm, 4.0mm, 5.0mm
- **Roll / Package Dimensions**: 1.0m × 10m / roll
- **Overview**: Premium polyester/fiberglass reinforced SBS torch-on membrane with unmatched low-temperature flexibility down to -25°C.
- **Applications**: Commercial flat roofing, basements, podium decks, subways, bridge decks, cold region infrastructure.
- **Key Features**: Low temperature flexibility down to -20°C / -25°C; High tensile strength and elongation (PY reinforcement); Excellent resistance to root puncture and cyclic thermal fatigue; Available in PE film, Fine Sand (S), Mineral Slate Granule (M) surfaces
- **Technical Parameters**:
  - Reinforcement: Polyester (PY) / Glass Fiber (G) / Composite (PYG)
  - Low Temp Flexibility: No cracks at -20°C (I) / -25°C (II)
  - Heat Resistance: 90°C (I) / 105°C (II), 2h without sliding
  - Tensile Strength (Long./Trans.): ≥ 500 / 400 N/50mm (3mm), ≥ 800 / 600 N/50mm (4mm)
  - Elongation at Break: ≥ 40% (PY Reinforced)
  - Water Impermeability: 0.3 MPa, 30 min watertight

### MZ-CAT-02: Plastomeric APP Modified Bitumen Waterproof Membrane
- **Category**: Modified Bitumen & Shingles
- **Execution Standards**: GB 18243-2008 / ASTM D6222 / EN 13707
- **Nominal Thickness / Spec**: 3.0mm, 4.0mm, 5.0mm
- **Roll / Package Dimensions**: 1.0m × 10m / roll
- **Overview**: Atactic Polypropylene modified bitumen torch-on membrane engineered for superior high-temperature stability (up to 130°C) in tropical/arid climates.
- **Applications**: Exposed tropical roofing, industrial factory decks, hot climate infrastructure, bridge piers.
- **Key Features**: High softening point and heat resistance up to 130°C; Outstanding UV and aging resistance for hot & tropical regions; Superior puncture and foot-traffic durability; Ideal for Middle East, Southeast Asia, South America, and Africa
- **Technical Parameters**:
  - Modifier Type: Atactic Polypropylene (APP) / APAO Polymer
  - Heat Resistance: 110°C (I) / 130°C (II), 2h no flow/drop
  - Low Temp Flexibility: -5°C (I) / -15°C (II)
  - Tensile Strength: ≥ 550 / 450 N/50mm (PY)
  - Elongation: ≥ 35%

### MZ-CAT-22: Cementitious Capillary Crystalline Waterproofing (CCCW)
- **Category**: Liquid Coatings & Slurry
- **Execution Standards**: GB 18445-2012 / ACI 212.3R-10
- **Nominal Thickness / Spec**: Applied as slurry coat (1.2 - 1.5 kg/m²) or Dry-Shake / Admixture
- **Roll / Package Dimensions**: 25 kg Valve Paper Bag / Plastic Drum
- **Overview**: Active chemical crystalline powder that reacts with moisture and unhydrated cement to grow insoluble dendritic crystals deep inside concrete capillaries.
- **Applications**: Tunnels, dams, subway stations, marine docks, water reservoirs, elevator pits.
- **Key Features**: Self-healing mechanism: reactivates whenever water appears to seal micro-cracks ≤ 0.4mm; Penetrates deep into concrete matrix (> 50mm over 12 months); Withstands extreme hydrostatic pressure (> 1.2 MPa); Does not require protection board against backfill damage
- **Technical Parameters**:
  - Crack Self-Healing Ability: Seals cracks up to 0.4 mm width
  - Hydrostatic Pressure Resistance: ≥ 1.2 MPa (120 m water head)
  - Depth of Crystal Penetration: > 50 mm

## 3. International Standards Compliance Matrix
### ASTM International
- **ASTM D6878**: Specification for Thermoplastic Polyolefin (TPO) Sheet Roofing
- **ASTM D4434**: Specification for Poly(Vinyl Chloride) Sheet Roofing
- **ASTM D6164**: Specification for SBS-Modified Bituminous Sheet (Polyester)
- **ASTM D6222**: Specification for APP-Modified Bituminous Sheet
- **ASTM C836**: High Solids Content Polyurethane Waterproofing

### European Standards (EN / CE)
- **EN 13707**: Flexible sheets for waterproofing - Reinforced bitumen sheets for roof waterproofing
- **EN 13956**: Flexible sheets for waterproofing - Plastic and rubber sheets for roof waterproofing
- **EN 13859-1**: Flexible sheets for waterproofing - Underlays for discontinuous roofing
- **EN 14909**: Flexible sheets for waterproofing - Plastic and rubber damp proof courses

### Chinese National Standards (GB)
- **GB 18242-2008**: Elastomer Modified Bituminous Sheet Materials (SBS)
- **GB 27789-2011**: Thermoplastic Polyolefin (TPO) Waterproof Sheets
- **GB 12952-2011**: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Waterproof Sheets
- **GB/T 23457-2017**: Pre-applied and Wet-installed Waterproof Membrane
- **GB/T 19250-2013**: Polyurethane Waterproof Coating

## 4. Technical & Export FAQ
### How to choose between SBS and APP modified bitumen waterproof membranes for different climates?
SBS (Styrene-Butadiene-Styrene) modified bitumen membrane (MZ-CAT-01) offers superior low-temperature flexibility down to -25°C, making it ideal for cold and temperate regions. APP (Atactic Polypropylene) modified bitumen membrane (MZ-CAT-02) provides high heat resistance up to +130°C and strong UV stability, engineered for tropical and high-temperature regions such as the Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, and South America.

### What international standards do Mingze waterproofing membranes and coatings comply with?
Our 37 waterproofing products are manufactured under ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 quality systems and tested to comply with ASTM D6164 (SBS), ASTM D6222 (APP), ASTM D6878 (TPO), ASTM D4434 (PVC), ASTM D5385 (Pre-applied HDPE), ASTM C836 (Polyurethane coating), European CE standards EN 13707 / EN 13956, and Chinese GB standards. Batch-specific COA, TDS, and MSDS documents are supplied with every shipment.

### What is the typical container loading capacity and production lead time from Qingdao Port?
Our 68,000 m² factory in Taitou Industrial Zone, Weifang is located 200 km (approx. 2.5 hours highway transit) from Qingdao Port. Standard production lead time for 20GP or 40HQ container orders is 7 to 10 days after order confirmation, with palletized export packaging.

### Do you provide OEM private-label branding and free physical sample swatch boxes?
Yes. We provide custom roll widths (1.0m / 2.0m), custom thickness, private-label PE film printing, and custom packaging for global distributors and contractors. Complimentary A4 physical membrane cuts and coating sample kits can be dispatched globally via DHL or FedEx for laboratory verification and project tender submittals.

### Which waterproofing membrane is recommended for blindside underground basements and tunnels?
For underground foundations, basements, and civil tunnels, we recommend Pre-Applied HDPE Self-Adhesive Waterproof Membrane (MZ-CAT-11, 1.2mm–2.0mm) compliant with ASTM D5385 and GB/T 23457, which forms a permanent chemical-mechanical bond with poured structural concrete to prevent lateral water migration, paired with EVA/ECB tunnel sheets (MZ-CAT-16) and HDPE dimple drainage boards (MZ-CAT-14 / MZ-CAT-34).

### How can overseas buyers request a factory FOB or CIF quotation?
Buyers can contact our export engineering desk directly via email at zhao@mzwaterproof.com (or zhao@mingzewaterproof.com) or via WhatsApp at +86 16658506707, stating the product model (e.g., MZ-CAT-01 to MZ-CAT-37), thickness, estimated quantity, and destination port. Formal FOB Qingdao or CIF quotations are issued within 24 hours.
